items.prompt: Every input price is invalid under the field contract. What should a mean calculation do?

options.text: Return an explicit no-result/error under its contract
options.why: There are no accepted observations to average.

options.text: Return zero and label it an observed average
options.why: That would invent a legitimate-looking result.

options.text: Use the number of rejected rows as the mean
options.why: A count and a price have different meanings and units.

options.text: Select a future price without recording it
options.why: That changes the information set and can create leakage.

items.explanation: Specify all-invalid behavior before aggregation. Zero can be a real numeric result elsewhere, so it is not a safe unlabelled failure marker.
